# Indian Travel House

> > Indian Travel House provides corporate car rental, employee transportation, and chauffeur-driven mobility solutions across India with fleet management services.

Indian Travel House (ITH), part of KSG Group, offers premium transportation services including corporate car rentals, employee transport solutions, wedding vehicles, and school buses across major Indian cities like Delhi, Noida, Ahmedabad, and Hyderabad. The company specializes in chauffeur-driven services with GPS-enabled fleet management for businesses and individuals.
